record.question: Under the Mizoram Police Manual, which of the following statements about the suspension of police personnel is NOT correct?
options: A member of a service may be placed under suspension from service, where an enquiry into grave charges against him is contemplated.
A member of a service may be placed under suspension from service, where a complaint against him of any criminal offence is under investigation.
A member of a service who is detained in custody whether on a criminal charge or otherwise, for a period longer than forty-eighty hours
A member of a service who is detained in custody whether on a criminal charge or otherwise, for a period longer than twenty-four hours
record.explanation: Suspension for custody requires longer than forty-eight hours, not twenty-four.
